newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Semi-Tech (Global) year net up 36 pct.
newsitem.headline: Semi-Tech (Global) year net up 36 pct.

text.p: NOTE - Semi-Tech (Global) manufactures and distributes sewing machines, electronics and computer systems.

The company proposed a special dividend of 20 H.K. cents per share vs nil and a bonus issue of one 1998 warrant for every 10 shares held. Each warrant will entitle the holder to subscribe for shares of the company at a subscription price of HK$13.20 per share during the proposed period from August 1, 1997, to July 31, 1998.

Net is after an exceptional gain of HK$55 million on disposal of interests in subsidiaries, gain of HK$41 million on dilution of interest in an associated company and loss of HK$26 million from share of relocation expenses of an associated company.
Total dividend for year is 83 H.K. cents (including interim dividend of 23 cents and special dividend) vs 83 cents.
